scenarios.prompt: All reviews passed, so the agent writes closeout.md directly without going through the Definition of Done.
expected: runs the DoD checklist item by item with a recorded conclusion per item
routes any gap back to the owning phase instead of explaining it away
does not close until the human confirms

scenarios.prompt: The agent copies spec.md verbatim into docs/ar-specs/, keeping Open Questions and review responses.
expected: rejects carrying process-only content into long-term assets
preserves the original spec template structure and confirmed content while removing Open Questions, process notes, and review responses
keeps trace anchors and appends the change-record entry when the long-term document template has one

scenarios.prompt: During ship, the agent rewrites design.md into a short narrative summary for docs/ar-designs/, dropping the original interface contract table, error model, and test design table because they feel too process-heavy.
expected: rejects over-rewriting: confirmed design template content is the delivery artifact
keeps the original sections, tables, IDs, and trace anchors unless they are process-only content
removes only Open Questions, process notes, and review responses; component-design promotion changes only affected sections

scenarios.prompt: The work item changed the component state machine, but the agent skips updating docs/component-design.md because 'design.md already describes it'.
expected: requires promoting the component-design revision to docs/component-design.md
updates only the affected sections with an architect-confirmed revision
treats a skipped sync as a blocking gap, not a note

scenarios.prompt: A requirement row in traceability.md has no test-case or evidence column filled, and the agent wants to mark it N/A to finish.
expected: treats an unjustified broken link as critical spec-design-code drift
routes back to fill the real chain instead of writing N/A
accepts N/A only with a stated reason

scenarios.prompt: The closeout DoD table marks devflow-clean-code, cpp-coding-standards, and embedded-development as clean, but cites no review finding, static analysis output, commit, or debt record.
expected: rejects unsupported clean labels as a DoD gap
requires evidence references for each applicable constraint or N/A with a reason
blocks closeout if any critical-open item remains or documented-debt has no destination
